technique.summary: Bypass SSRF protections that validate hostnames by resolving a DNS name that alternates between a public IP and an internal IP (127.0.0.1, 169.254.169.254). The first resolution passes the check, the second hits the internal target.
steps: Identify an endpoint that fetches a user-supplied URL
Confirm the application validates the resolved IP against an allowlist/blocklist
Set up a DNS rebinding service (e.g., rbndr.us, 1u.ms) that alternates between a safe IP and the target internal IP
Submit the rebinding domain as the URL parameter
The first DNS resolution returns the safe IP (passes validation)
The second resolution (actual fetch) returns the internal IP
Extract the response containing internal service data

payloads.notes: 1u.ms service — configure to return attacker IP first, then target

bypassTechniques: Use short TTL to defeat DNS caching
Race condition: make multiple rapid requests to increase rebinding success rate
Use TOCTOU gap between validation and fetch
